              ** faulty since 11/27/2022

            - routine site maintenance, including: 
               - checked anemometer (replaced bearings)

               - weed removal (site well-maintained by host) 
 
               * site does not make use of a canopy leaf wetness sensor

04/21/2004: Telecommunication Trouble Corrected (crn, sm): 
 
            - Faulty COM100 Cell Phone Modem Replaced.  Station 
              returned to regular 6:35am/6:35pm data collection 
              schedule. 
 
 
04/13/2004: Telecommunication Trouble: 
 
            - Currently unable to connect to cell modem installed 
              at the Sandusky MAWN station.  Data will likely be 
              unavailable until we are able to service the trouble (jtb). 
 
 
01/12/2004: Station Online: 
 
            - Data Collection and Data Archive for new station begins and 
              now made available via the MAWN website: 
 
                 First data report:   Jan 01, 2004 - 00:05   (Day=001) 
 
 
01/08/2004: Communications Troubleshooting: 
 
            - PC208W Communication software now properly configured 
              thanks to suggestions provided by Campbell Scientific. 
              The following modem string was needed to properly  
              handshake with COM200 installed in the field: 
 
                 &B1V1X3S7=60&M0&N2 
 
 
01/02/2004: Cellular Package Troubleshooting: 
 
            - Thumb Cellular replaced Motorola Transceiver and  
              communication to/from station appears to be OK. 
 
            - PC208W still needs to be configured
